responsibility: Serves as the crate root for `rustc_type_ir`, assembling the interner-agnostic type IR by declaring and re-exporting its modules and by defining crate-wide foundational indices and enums such as De Bruijn indices, universes, bound variables, variance, and closure kinds. It is the integration point that exposes the shared type-system representation and common utilities consumed by the trait solver and by downstream compiler crates.
